response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS rating_average FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS overall_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.rating_average, ra.rating_average - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND ra.rating_average > o.overall_mean
